responsibility: Implements the arithmetic, formatting, comparison, scaling, serialization, and quality-propagation logic for GCC’s profile_count and profile_probability abstractions. This file defines profile quality name tables, dump/debug helpers, tolerant difference checks, LTO streaming, safe 64-bit scaling, conversions from gcov counters, legacy frequency conversion, sreal scaling, and cross-function IPA profile adjustment/composition rules. It is the executable semantics behind GCC’s typed profile values rather than the API declarations alone.
same_name_distinction: This file provides the out-of-line behavior for profile_count/profile_probability, such as dumping, parsing quality names, tolerant comparisons, LTO streaming, safe scaling, frequency conversion, and IPA adjustment/composition rules. Unlike gcc/profile-count.h, it is not the primary type definition layer; it supplies the non-inline operational semantics behind those classes.
